tips.title: Open a part file and assign a machine definition
tips.body: Start Mastercam, select the default metric configuration file, open the part file 'single_contour.mcam', and choose a wire EDM machine definition.

tips.title: Create a contour toolpath with a single contour
tips.body: On the Wireframe tab, choose Point Position and create a thread point at X-40, Y0.2, Z0.

tips.title: Define stock model for better visualization
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, set up stock boundaries with dimensions Y75, X75, Z10 and a Z origin of 10.

tips.title: Select geometry for toolpath chaining
tips.body: On the Wirepaths tab, choose Contour and chain the thread point with the gear shape.

tips.title: Enter wire path parameters
tips.body: Set Wire Diameter to 0.2, Compensation Type to Computer, and Taper settings for UV height.

tips.title: Backplot the toolpath to check for errors
tips.body: Click Backplot selected operations, display wire and guides, and run the backplot to verify the path.

tips.title: Change toolpath parameters for better machining
tips.body: Modify parameters and update the operation to include new settings for more effective machining.

tips.title: Set Wire Overburn for Passes
Add Additional Skim Cuts
tips.body: Enter 3 for additional skim cuts before tab.

tips.title: Set Tab Width
tips.body: Enter 1.0 for tab width.

tips.title: Select Reverse Cutting Method
tips.body: Set cutting method to Reverse.

tips.title: Set Arc Radius and Sweep for Leads
tips.body: Enter 0.125 for arc radius and 60 for arc sweep.

tips.title: Set Maximum Leadout Distance
tips.body: Enter 0.3 for maximum leadout distance.

tips.title: Select Glue Stop for Output Stop Code
tips.body: Choose As glue stop for output stop code.

tips.title: Select Arc Motion for Leads and Leadout
tips.body: Select Line and arc for lead in, Arc and line for lead out.

tips.title: Set Overlap for Multiple Contour Toolpath
tips.body: Enter 0.02 for overlap.

tips.title: Set Rapid Height for Taper
tips.body: Enter 20.0 for rapid height.

tips.title: Sort Chains in Chain Manager
tips.body: Select Y+X option for sorting chains.

tips.title: Verify selected operations in Toolpaths Manager
tips.body: Click 'Verify' at the top of the Toolpaths Manager to display stock, wire, and guides in the Mastercam Simulator window.

tips.title: Set up NoCore stock in Mastercam Wire
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, expand Properties under Machine Group and click Stock setup. Set Shape to Cylindrical, Axis to Z, Height to 30, Diameter to 40.

tips.title: Select thread points for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: On the Wireframe tab, choose Point Position and select ThreadPoint. Move cursor to end of a slot to detect center of an arc.

tips.title: Set up 4-axis stock in Mastercam Wire
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, expand Properties under Makino Machine Group and click Stock setup. Set Shape to Cylindrical, Axis to Z, Height to 40, Diameter to 70.

tips.title: Select geometry for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: In the Wirepath tabs, choose 4 Axis. Select thread point to left of part as first chain and lower purple contour to right of green point as XY plane.

tips.title: Set up synchronization for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: In the Chaining dialog box, select by Entity to match endpoints of each entity. Click OK to close the Chaining Options dialog box.

tips.title: Configure power settings for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Choose Wire/Power from the TreeView pane and click the Tech button to change power settings for this toolpath.

tips.title: Select number of passes for part
tips.body: Choose 3 from Sequencedrop-downlist at bottom of dialog box.

tips.title: Set UV and XY tabs to same size
tips.body: Select Equal in Tabs section, enter 1.5 for XY Tab Width.

tips.title: Set compensation type and direction
tips.body: Choose Compensation, set type to Computer and direction to Left.

tips.title: Add stop codes before each tab cut
tips.body: Choose Stops, select Foreach to add a stop code before the first tab cut on each chain and As glue stop to add them as optional stops.

tips.title: Select lead-in and lead-out paths
tips.body: Choose Leads, select Line and arc for the lead-in and Arc and line for the lead-out.

tips.title: View shaded part with toolpath
tips.body: Press [Alt+S] to view the shaded part with the toolpath.

tips.title: Backplot tool motion in Mastercam Simulator
tips.body: Click Verify selected operations at top of Toolpaths Manager, check Workpiece to shade the solid, click Backplot to change to Backplot mode.

tips.title: Enable vectors for 4-axis wire positions
tips.body: Click the Backplottab and select Enable Vectors to view the 4-axis wire positions as it moves around the part.

tips.title: Run backplot and observe tool motion
tips.body: Click Play at bottom of Simulator window to run the backplot, observe wire movement around part.

tips.title: View final part shapes for comparison
tips.body: Click the Hometab and select Workpiece to see the final part shapes, compare with tool motion.
